## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Identify which app(s)
are affected and include a screenshot when changing the phone UI.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` (or explain which app-specific checks apply)
- [ ] `npm run pack` when changing builds, manifests, dependencies, or installation
- [ ] README / CONTRIBUTING / CHANGELOG updated where relevant

Record simulator and real-hardware results separately, including both app
versions, phone/Android version, Even App version, and radio firmware where known.
Describe anything still unverified. Do not include connection keys or pairing codes.
